name: tract_developer_codes_desired
description: Tests 1 and 2, by hand from 4.1 and 4.2. The outcome codes are 0..27 in table order and 'best' is the numeric maximum (Success 27 is the largest). desired = max(1, trunc(demand)), desiredMax = trunc(r24(float(desired) x overbuild)): 7.9 -> 7, trunc(r24(7 x 1.5)) = trunc(10.5) = 10; 0.3 -> trunc 0 -> 1, desiredMax trunc(1.5) = 1; -5.0 -> 1, 1; NaN -> _ftol gives 0 (low 32 bits of 0x8000000000000000) -> max(1, 0) = 1, 1; no demand node [choice] reads 0 -> 1, 1. Overbuild 2.25 with demand 3 -> 3, trunc(6.75) = 6. Then one Grow with demand 7.9 and no lot configuration at all (ListPossibleLotConfigurations returns 5, nothing is listed or pushed, two passes) leaves desired / desiredMax 7 / 10 in the working state and an empty outcome list.
